findings.evidence: Carried from r2-k04-overlays-27. packages/ui-react/src/components/preview-card/preview-card.test.tsx:7; portal-container/overlay-portals.test.tsx:33-92.
findings.fix: Add a portal test and interaction tests.

findings.subject: preview-card
findings.summary: PreviewCard has no height cap and no safe-area width cap.
findings.evidence: Carried from r2-k04-overlays-10. packages/ui-react/src/components/preview-card/preview-card.css:13-37 vs hover-card.css:24-33.
findings.fix: Share HoverCard's max-width/max-height rules.

findings.subject: sheet
findings.summary: Sheet edges and inset radius bypass the overlay contract tokens.
findings.evidence: Carried from r2-k04-overlays-31. packages/ui-react/src/components/sheet/sheet.css:105,113,123,134,149,156,173 (--a63-control-border-width, now also on the new logical sides) and 174,221-222 (--radius-2xl); #377 does not touch sheet.css.
findings.fix: Use --a63-overlay-border-width/style and var(--a63-overlay-radius, var(--radius-2xl)).

findings.subject: alert-dialog
findings.summary: The alert-dialog footer's corner radius is hardcoded to --radius-2xl while the popup uses the overlay radius.
findings.evidence: Carried from r2-k04-overlays-32. packages/ui-react/src/components/alert-dialog/alert-dialog.css:160-161 vs alert-dialog.css:57 and dialog.css:182-183.
findings.fix: Use calc(var(--a63-overlay-radius, var(--radius-2xl)) - 1px) like Dialog.

findings.subject: dialog
findings.summary: A bottom-placed dialog on a phone squares all corners while Drawer keeps a top radius.
findings.evidence: Carried from r2-k04-overlays-34. packages/ui-react/src/components/dialog/dialog.css:88-95 vs drawer/drawer.css:149-150; apps/storybook/visual/__screenshots__/ui-react-dialog-open-phone-chromium-linux.png.
findings.fix: Decide whether a phone bottom sheet keeps its top radius.

findings.subject: alert-dialog
findings.summary: Alert dialog has no phone story or baseline.
findings.evidence: Carried from r2-k04-overlays-35. apps/storybook/visual/__screenshots__/(no ui-react-alertdialog-*-phone png).
findings.fix: Add an OpenPhone story like dialog.stories.tsx:155.

findings.subject: drawer
findings.summary: Drawer Trigger/Close keep asChild beside render, and Header/Footer/Body lack render, unlike the other overlays.
findings.evidence: Carried from r2-k04-overlays-36. packages/ui-react/src/components/drawer/drawer.tsx:19,58-69,112-117,140-145 (asChild beside render); Header/Footer/Body plain divs.
findings.fix: Pick one composition API across overlays; deprecate asChild here or document why.

findings.subject: preview-card
findings.summary: preview-card/index.ts exports HoverCard aliases that the root shadows with hover-card's.
findings.evidence: Carried from r2-k04-overlays-37. packages/ui-react/src/components/preview-card/index.ts:1-8; src/index.ts:351,478.
findings.fix: Drop the aliases from preview-card/index.ts (covered by the hover-card K8 decision).

findings.subject: alert-dialog
findings.summary: The alert-dialog media chip uses literal sizes.
findings.evidence: Carried from r2-k04-overlays-38. packages/ui-react/src/components/alert-dialog/alert-dialog.css:169-181 (2.5rem / 1.5rem).
findings.fix: Use control/icon size tokens.

findings.subject: dialog
findings.summary: Nine of the ten overlay docs pages still repeat the same two generic group guidance lines; only Toaster has its own.
findings.evidence: Carried from r2-k04-overlays-40. apps/docs/src/lib/component-docs.ts:22 (overlays group guidance), :200 (item.guidance overrides it only where set; only toaster sets it in apps/docs/src/lib/component-catalog.ts).
findings.fix: Write per-component guidance (when to choose, dismissal, sizing).

findings.subject: sheet
findings.summary: The default sheet side is the physical right edge, so a default sheet in a right-to-left page opens from the reading end.
findings.evidence: New in r3. packages/ui-foundation/contracts/components/sheet.json:29 defaultSide "right"; packages/ui-react/src/components/sheet/sheet.tsx:136,167 (side = sheetContract.defaultSide). The logical inline-end side already exists (sheet.css:57-67,141-168).
findings.fix: Make inline-end the contract default (unchanged in LTR) and keep right for callers that want the physical edge; add a changeset. PR #377 does exactly this (sheet.json defaultSide inline-end, sheet.test.tsx expects data-side inline-end).

findings.subject: toaster
findings.summary: A toned toast conveys its tone only by the shape of an unnamed icon, so a screen reader announces the message without saying it is an error, warning or success.
findings.evidence: New in r3. packages/ui-react/src/components/toaster/toaster.tsx:156-162 (icons map: bare lucide icons, no label, no status text); toaster.css has no per-tone rule; toaster.test.tsx:72-91 checks the live region but not the tone.
findings.fix: Prefix each toned toast with a visually hidden, translatable status word and hide the icon from assistive technology; test it. PR #377 adds statusLabels, a .a63-Toast-status span and aria-hidden icons with a test.

findings.subject: toaster
findings.summary: All toast tones draw their icon in the text colour, so error, warning, success and info read alike at a glance.
findings.evidence: New in r3. apps/storybook/visual/__screenshots__/ui-react-toaster-themes-chromium-linux.png (every icon in the text colour in all 8 cells); packages/ui-react/src/components/toaster/toaster.css (no [data-type] rule).
findings.fix: Colour each toned icon with its --a63-status-* role (3:1 on the overlay surface). PR #377 adds these rules to toaster.css.
